ja433:1.1: Assa Inda-samo rāja accantaṃ ajarāmaro sace tvaṃ yaññaṃ yājeyya isiṃ Lomasakassapan ti.
ja433:2.1: Sasamuddapariyāyaṃ mahiṃ sāgarakuṇḍalaṃ (Cfr. p..) na icche saha nindāya, evaṃ Sayha vijānahi.
ja433:3.1: Dhi-r-atthu taṃ yasalābhaṃ dhanalābhañ ca brāhmaṇa yā vutti vinipātena adhammacaraṇena vā.
ja433:4.1: Api ce pattam ādāya anāgāro paribbaje sā eva jīvikā seyyā yā cādhammena esanā.
ja433:5.1: Api ce pattam ādāya anāgāro paribbaje aññaṃ ahiṃsayaṃ loke api rajjena taṃ varan ti.
ja433:6.1: Balaṃ cando balaṃ suriyo balaṃ samaṇabrāhmaṇā balaṃ velā samuddassa balātibalam itthiyo.
ja433:7.1: Yathā uggatapaṃ santaṃ isiṃ Lomasakassapaṃ pitu atthā Candavatī vācapeyyaṃ ayājayīti.
ja433:8.1: Taṃ lobhā pakataṃ kammaṃ kaṭukaṃ kāmahetukaṃ, tassa mūlaṃ gavesissaṃ, checchaṃ rāgaṃ sabandhanan ti.
ja433:9.1: Dhi-r-atthu kāme subahū pi loke, tapo va seyyo kāmaguṇehi rāja, tapo karissāmi pahāya kāme, tav' eva raṭṭhaṃ Candavatī ca hotū 'ti.
